_comment: Document types for Additional Documents, and when each applies. Edit here - no code change. offerAlways (1-7) lists a type in the Document Type dropdown for everyone, in that order, ahead of the contextual ones. appliesTo dimensions (all given must match; omit one for no restriction; an empty list means never): journeys, personas (role ids), products (postpaid|prepaid|mnp|fixed-line), idTypes, segments (customer segment, matched by prefix: 'Enterprise' matches 'Enterprise (EBU)'), conditions (all must hold). Conditions are computed from the journey draft: number-waiver, minor-applicant, special-discount:mada|b2b2c|retired, actual-user-other, manual-caf, upfront-payment, vat-registration. requiredWhen (conditions) makes the document required, asked for as its own card. basis says where each rule comes from; 'assumed' rules need business confirmation.
